spine: 1. 讀者的具體場景：要替使用者或 AI 生成的程式碼開一個一次性的執行環境，要強隔離（不可信程式碼）、要快（互動式體驗）、還要在同一個 session 裡保留狀態。
2. 既有缺口：VM 隔離強但啟動要好幾分鐘；container 秒啟但 shared-kernel 要大量自訂 hardening 才敢跑不可信程式碼。兩端都不剛好。
3. 新原語：Lambda MicroVMs 是 Lambda 裡的新 serverless compute primitive，由 Firecracker 支撐——同一套已撐起 Lambda 每月逾 15 兆次呼叫的輕量虛擬化。
4. 機制核心一：snapshot。create-microvm-image 跑你的 Dockerfile、初始化應用，對記憶體與磁碟狀態取一份 Firecracker snapshot；之後每個 microVM 從這份 pre-initialized snapshot resume，不冷開機，所以啟動與 idle resume 都近乎即啟。
5. 機制核心二：stateful + suspend/resume。一個 microVM 在 session 期間保留 memory、disk、running processes；idle 時可 suspend（記憶體與磁碟狀態保留）、有流量再 resume，靠 idle policy 控制。
6. 規格邊界：ARM64、最高 16 vCPU / 32GB 記憶體 / 32GB 磁碟、單次最長 8 小時；先在 US East、US West、Ireland、Tokyo 開放；2026-06-22 起 Now available。
7. 適用場景與取捨：AI coding assistant、互動式程式碼環境、資料分析、漏洞掃描、跑使用者腳本的遊戲伺服器——這些都是「per-session 隔離 + 保狀態 + 要快」三者同時成立的工作。

perspective.mechanism: 把 Firecracker 的 snapshot/restore 與 suspend/resume 包成兩個 Lambda API（create-microvm-image、run-microvm），用 pre-initialized snapshot 取代 cold boot，並讓單一 microVM 在 session 內保留 memory/disk/process 狀態。
perspective.tradeoff: 換來 VM 級隔離 + 近乎即啟 + 保狀態的同時，受 ARM64、16 vCPU/32GB mem/32GB disk、單次 8 小時、四個區域的硬上限約束；且每個 microVM 綁一個 end user/session，不是傳統 function 那種高密度短命呼叫。
perspective.reader_use: 要替不可信或 AI 生成的程式碼開沙箱（coding assistant、線上 IDE、資料分析、漏洞掃描、遊戲腳本）的工程師，可以不必自己在 container 上堆 hardening 或自管 Firecracker 機隊。

perspective.mechanism: Firecracker 用 KVM 建立 microVM，配一個最小化 device model（只五個模擬裝置），所以開機快、記憶體 overhead 低，又保有 VM 級的硬體隔離邊界。
perspective.tradeoff: 極簡 device model 換來啟動速度與密度（<5 MiB overhead、每 host 每秒可建 150 個），代價是裝置功能被刻意砍到最少。
perspective.reader_use: 讓讀者理解 Lambda microVMs 底層為何能同時做到隔離與快——隔離來自 KVM/microVM 邊界，快來自最小 device model 加 snapshot。

notes.quote: AWS Lambda MicroVMs, a new serverless compute primitive within AWS Lambda that lets you run code generated by users or AI in isolated, stateful execution environments.
notes.interpretation: 定位句：microVM 是 Lambda 裡的新 compute primitive，目標是跑使用者或 AI 生成的程式碼，環境同時是 isolated 且 stateful。

notes.quote: Lambda MicroVMs are powered by Firecracker, the same lightweight virtualization technology that has powered over 15 trillions of monthly Lambda function invocations.
notes.interpretation: 底層是 Firecracker，且強調這是已撐起 Lambda 每月逾 15 兆次呼叫的同一套技術——用既有規模背書。原文寫 15 trillions，照引。

notes.quote: Virtual machines deliver strong isolation but take minutes to start. Containers launch in seconds, yet their shared-kernel architecture requires significant custom hardening to safely contain untrusted code.
notes.interpretation: 缺口陳述：VM 隔離強但啟動以分鐘計；container 秒啟但 shared-kernel 要大量自訂 hardening 才能安全裝不可信程式碼。這就是 microVM 要補的兩端。

notes.quote: Lambda MicroVMs is purpose-built for exactly this gap.
notes.interpretation: 明說 microVM 就是為了補上 VM 與 container 之間那道缺口而設計。

notes.quote: Lambda runs your Dockerfile, initializes your application, and takes a Firecracker snapshot of the running environment's memory and disk state. Every subsequent MicroVM launched from that image resumes from the pre-initialized snapshot rather than booting cold, which means launches and idle resumes both achieve near-instant startup latency.
notes.interpretation: snapshot 機制全文：跑 Dockerfile→初始化→對 memory 與 disk 取 Firecracker snapshot；之後每個 microVM 從 pre-initialized snapshot resume 而非冷開機，所以 launch 與 idle resume 都近乎即啟。「near-instant」是原文用詞，未給毫秒數。

notes.quote: Each MicroVM gives a single end user or session its own isolated environment that launches rapidly, retains memory and disk state for the length of the session, and pauses to a low idle cost when the user steps away.
notes.interpretation: 單位是「一個 end user / session 一個 microVM」；session 期間保留 memory 與 disk 狀態；使用者離開時 pause 到 low idle cost。原文用 low idle cost，未給數字。

notes.quote: A running MicroVM retains memory, disk, and running processes across the user's session. During idle periods, a MicroVM can be suspended – with memory and disk state intact – and resumed when traffic arrives.
notes.interpretation: stateful 與 suspend/resume：running microVM 在 session 內保留 memory、disk、running processes；idle 期間可 suspended（memory 與 disk state intact），有 traffic 再 resumed。
idle policy 的具體形狀：maxIdleDurationSeconds、suspendedDurationSeconds、autoResumeEnabled 三個欄位。範例值 900/300/true。這是 run-microvm 的參數。

notes.quote: create-microvm-image: Packages Dockerfile and code artifact; Lambda builds image and snapshots initialized application state. run-microvm: Launches a MicroVM from an image with specified execution role and idle policy; returns unique ID and dedicated endpoint URL.
notes.interpretation: 兩個新 API 的職責：create-microvm-image 把 Dockerfile + code artifact 打包，Lambda build image 並對初始化後的應用狀態取 snapshot；run-microvm 從 image 啟一個 microVM、帶 execution role 與 idle policy，回傳唯一 ID 與專屬 endpoint URL。

notes.quote: ARM64 | up to 16 vCPUs | 32 GB of memory | 32 GB of disk per MicroVM | MicroVMs support up to 8 hours of total runtime
notes.interpretation: 規格上限逐項照引：架構 ARM64；最高 16 vCPUs；32 GB 記憶體；每個 microVM 32 GB 磁碟；單次最長 8 小時 total runtime。

notes.quote: US East (N. Virginia, Ohio), US West (Oregon), Europe (Ireland) and Asia Pacific (Tokyo)
notes.interpretation: 開放區域逐字照引：US East（N. Virginia、Ohio）、US West（Oregon）、Europe（Ireland）、Asia Pacific（Tokyo）。

notes.quote: AI coding assistants, interactive code environments, data analytics platforms, vulnerability scanners, and game servers that run user-supplied scripts
notes.interpretation: 場景清單照引：AI coding assistants、interactive code environments、data analytics platforms、vulnerability scanners，以及跑 user-supplied scripts 的 game servers。
發布日期 2026-06-22；狀態 Now available（非 preview）。

notes.quote: Firecracker is an open source virtualization technology that is purpose-built for creating and managing secure, multi-tenant container and function-based services.
notes.interpretation: Firecracker 自我定位：開源虛擬化技術，為安全的 multi-tenant container 與 function 服務而生。

notes.quote: lightweight virtual machines, called microVMs, which provide enhanced security and workload isolation over traditional VMs, while enabling the speed and resource efficiency of containers.
notes.interpretation: microVM 的官方定義：輕量 VM，提供優於傳統 VM 的安全與隔離，同時有 container 的速度與資源效率。這正是「兼得」的來源。

notes.quote: Firecracker initiates user space or application code in as little as 125 ms and supports microVM creation rates of up to 150 microVMs per second per host.
notes.interpretation: Firecracker 本身的啟動數字：as little as 125 ms 起 user space，host 每秒可建最多 150 個 microVM。注意這是 Firecracker 冷啟數字，不是 Lambda microVMs 從 snapshot resume 的數字（後者原文只說 near-instant，未給毫秒）。

notes.quote: Each Firecracker microVM runs with a reduced memory overhead of less than 5 MiB, enabling a high density of microVMs to be packed on each server.
notes.interpretation: 每個 Firecracker microVM 記憶體 overhead <5 MiB，所以單機可塞高密度。

notes.quote: the Linux Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM) to create and manage microVMs ... a minimal device model that excludes all non-essential functionality
notes.interpretation: 底層機制：用 KVM 建/管 microVM，配一個最小 device model，砍掉所有非必要功能（原文後續列出 virtio-net、virtio-block、virtio-vsock、serial console、keyboard controller 五個）。這是「快」的來源。

claims.claim_text: AWS 在 6 月 22 日上線的 Lambda microVMs … 把 Firecracker 的 snapshot 與 suspend/resume 兩個底層能力，包成了兩個可以直接呼叫的 API。
claims.evidence: by Micah Walter on 22 JUN 2026 … Now available; a new serverless compute primitive within AWS Lambda that lets you run code generated by users or AI in isolated, stateful execution environments.
claims.note: 發布日 2026-06-22 與「包成兩個 API」均由源支持。

claims.claim_text: AWS 自己列的場景就是這幾類——原文寫的是「AI coding assistants, interactive code environments, data analytics platforms, vulnerability scanners, and game servers that run user-supplied scripts」。
claims.location: H2「那段你不敢直接 exec 的程式碼」
claims.evidence: AI coding assistants, interactive code environments, data analytics platforms, vulnerability scanners, and game servers that run user-supplied scripts
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: AWS 在公告裡的講法很直白：「Virtual machines deliver strong isolation but take minutes to start.」
claims.evidence: Virtual machines deliver strong isolation but take minutes to start.
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 同一份公告接著說「Containers launch in seconds, yet their shared-kernel architecture requires significant custom hardening to safely contain untrusted code.」
claims.evidence: Containers launch in seconds, yet their shared-kernel architecture requires significant custom hardening to safely contain untrusted code.
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「AWS Lambda MicroVMs, a new serverless compute primitive within AWS Lambda that lets you run code generated by users or AI in isolated, stateful execution environments.」
claims.evidence: a new serverless compute primitive within AWS Lambda that lets you run code generated by users or AI in isolated, stateful execution environments
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「Lambda MicroVMs are powered by Firecracker, the same lightweight virtualization technology that has powered over 15 trillions of monthly Lambda function invocations.」… 每月逾 15 兆次呼叫（原文寫 15 trillions，照引）
claims.evidence: Lambda MicroVMs are powered by Firecracker, the same lightweight virtualization technology that has powered over 15 trillions of monthly Lambda function invocations.
claims.note: 逐字相符；作者明確標註「原文寫 15 trillions，照引」，保留源頭非標準用法。

claims.claim_text: Firecracker 對自己的定位是「an open source virtualization technology that is purpose-built for creating and managing secure, multi-tenant container and function-based services」。
claims.evidence: Firecracker is an open source virtualization technology that is purpose-built for creating and managing secure, multi-tenant container and function-based services.
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「lightweight virtual machines, called microVMs, which provide enhanced security and workload isolation over traditional VMs, while enabling the speed and resource efficiency of containers」
claims.evidence: lightweight virtual machines, called microVMs, which provide enhanced security and workload isolation over traditional VMs, while enabling the speed and resource efficiency of containers.
claims.note: 逐字相符，為全文「兼得」論點的根。

claims.claim_text: Firecracker 用 Linux 的 KVM 來建立與管理 microVM … 配的是「a minimal device model that excludes all non-essential functionality」，… 只留 virtio-net、virtio-block、virtio-vsock、serial console 與 keyboard controller 五個模擬裝置
claims.evidence: uses the Linux Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM) to create and manage microVMs; Firecracker also implements a minimal device model that excludes all non-essential functionality; only 5 emulated devices are available: virtio-net, virtio-block, virtio-vsock, serial console, and a minimal keyboard controller used only to stop the microVM
claims.note: KVM、minimal device model 引號逐字相符；五個裝置清單與源一致。

claims.claim_text: Firecracker 的數字是「initiates user space or application code in as little as 125 ms and supports microVM creation rates of up to 150 microVMs per second per host」——最快 125 ms 起 user space，每台 host 每秒最多建 150 個 microVM。
claims.evidence: Firecracker initiates user space or application code in as little as 125 ms and supports microVM creation rates of up to 150 microVMs per second per host.
claims.note: 125 ms 與 150/sec 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 每個 microVM 的記憶體 overhead「less than 5 MiB」
claims.evidence: Each Firecracker microVM runs with a reduced memory overhead of less than 5 MiB, enabling a high density of microVMs to be packed on each server.
claims.note: <5 MiB 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 但 125 ms 是 Firecracker「冷啟動一個全新 microVM」的數字 … Firecracker 文件裡那個 125 ms 是它冷啟一個全新 microVM 的數字，不能直接當成 Lambda microVMs 從 snapshot resume 的延遲。
claims.location: H2「新原語」段尾 + H2「不冷啟動」段
claims.evidence: near-instant startup latency (AWS, no ms given); Firecracker initiates user space or application code in as little as 125 ms (Firecracker page, cold-start).
claims.note: 關鍵防混淆檢查：prose 正確區分——125 ms 歸給 Firecracker 冷啟，Lambda snapshot-resume 只用 near-instant、未給毫秒。無 conflation。

claims.claim_text: create-microvm-image：用我的話講，這個 API 收下一份 Dockerfile 與程式碼，由 Lambda 打包、build 成 image，並對初始化後的應用狀態取 snapshot … run-microvm 從 image 啟一個 microVM，帶上你指定的 execution role 與 idle policy，啟好之後回傳一個唯一 ID 與一個專屬的 endpoint URL
claims.evidence: Lambda retrieved the zip, ran the Dockerfile, initialized the application, and took a Firecracker snapshot of the running disk and memory state.; Lambda assigned the MicroVM a unique ID, returned a dedicated endpoint URL, and started a new MicroVM ... resumed from a snapshot; image ARN and an idle policy configured to auto-suspend ... and auto-resume on the next incoming request.
claims.note: Round 2：作者已移除原本被以「」/原文框成 verbatim 的兩串捏造 API-表格文字（round 1 標 unverifiable 的點），改寫為明標『用我的話講』的自身 paraphrase，僅保留真實 API 名稱（create-microvm-image、run-microvm）與已核實的實質（build image + snapshot 初始化狀態；帶 execution role + idle policy 啟動、回傳 id + endpoint URL）。不再把不存在的字串當源頭逐字引用；paraphrase 的實質與公告敘事相符，無 hedge 升級。verdict 由 unverifiable 轉 verified。

claims.claim_text: 公告的關鍵句是「Lambda runs your Dockerfile, initializes your application, and takes a Firecracker snapshot of the running environment's memory and disk state.」
claims.evidence: Lambda runs your Dockerfile, initializes your application, and takes a Firecracker snapshot of the running environment's memory and disk state.
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「Every subsequent MicroVM launched from that image resumes from the pre-initialized snapshot rather than booting cold, which means launches and idle resumes both achieve near-instant startup latency.」
claims.location: arch-microvm-api 圖 detail 面板（d-run）+ H2「不冷啟動」
claims.evidence: Every subsequent MicroVM launched from that image resumes from the pre-initialized snapshot rather than booting cold, which means launches and idle resumes both achieve near-instant startup latency.
claims.note: 逐字相符；prose 保留 near-instant 未升級為毫秒數。

claims.claim_text: 合理的推測是，從 snapshot resume 比冷啟還要快，因為連那 125 ms 的開機都省了——但這是推斷，公告沒給數字。
claims.evidence: Source gives 'near-instant' for resume and '125 ms' for Firecracker cold-start, but no comparison between them.
claims.note: 作者明確以「合理的推測是…」「但這是推斷，公告沒給數字」標註為推斷——出處四態之推斷，標記正當，無需 action。

claims.claim_text: 「Each MicroVM gives a single end user or session its own isolated environment that launches rapidly, retains memory and disk state for the length of the session.」
claims.evidence: Each MicroVM gives a single end user or session its own isolated environment that launches rapidly, retains memory and disk state for the length of the session, and pauses to a low idle cost when the user steps away.
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「A running MicroVM retains memory, disk, and running processes across the user's session.」連 running processes 都保留
claims.evidence: A running MicroVM retains memory, disk, and running processes across the user's session.
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 公告寫：「During idle periods, a MicroVM can be suspended – with memory and disk state intact – and resumed when traffic arrives.」… 「pauses to a low idle cost when the user steps away」，用的是 low idle cost，沒給具體價格。
claims.evidence: During idle periods, a MicroVM can be suspended – with memory and disk state intact – and resumed when traffic arrives.; pauses to a low idle cost when the user steps away
claims.note: 兩段逐字相符；作者正確指出 low idle cost 未給數字。

claims.claim_text: --idle-policy '{"maxIdleDurationSeconds":900,"suspendedDurationSeconds":300,"autoResumeEnabled":true}'（範例 900/300/true）
claims.location: H2「保狀態與 suspend」config code block
claims.evidence: '{"maxIdleDurationSeconds":900,"suspendedDurationSeconds":300,"autoResumeEnabled":true}'
claims.note: 三欄位名稱與 900/300/true 值逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 架構是 ARM64；最高 up to 16 vCPUs；32 GB of memory；每個 microVM 32 GB of disk；單次最長 MicroVMs support up to 8 hours of total runtime。
claims.location: H2「邊界在哪」+ stack-cards spec 卡
claims.evidence: on the ARM64 architecture, with up to 16 vCPUs, 32 GB of memory, and 32 GB of disk per MicroVM; MicroVMs support up to 8 hours of total runtime
claims.note: ARM64 / 16 vCPU / 32GB mem / 32GB disk / 8h 全部逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 區域目前只有四個：US East（N. Virginia、Ohio）、US West（Oregon）、Europe（Ireland）、Asia Pacific（Tokyo）。
claims.location: H2「邊界在哪」+ spec 卡 REGIONS
claims.evidence: available today in the US East (N. Virginia, Ohio), US West (Oregon), Europe (Ireland) and Asia Pacific (Tokyo) Regions
claims.note: 四區逐字相符；timeliness volatile 但源為發布當日（2026-06-22），與貼文 2026-06-27 同期，無需加日期 hedge。

claims.claim_text: 發布狀態是 2026 年 6 月 22 日的「Now available」，不是 preview … 價格公告沒列在文內，只說在 Lambda pricing page 上。
claims.evidence: by Micah Walter on 22 JUN 2026; Now available; Pricing details can be found on the AWS Lambda pricing page
claims.note: 發布日、Now available、價格指向 pricing page 三點均相符。

claims.claim_text: 「VM 級隔離又能秒啟又保狀態」… 靠一份預先初始化的記憶體快照同時成立 / microVM 不是更大的 function，而是一份『預先開機到一半、隨時可以喚醒』的 Firecracker 快照
claims.evidence: resumes from the pre-initialized snapshot rather than booting cold; retains memory and disk state for the length of the session; provide enhanced security and workload isolation over traditional VMs, while enabling the speed and resource efficiency of containers.
claims.note: 全文骨幹論點：隔離=VM 邊界、速度=不冷啟動、保狀態=session 綁同一 microVM、省錢=suspend；逐項對應已核實的源文，無 hedge 升級。
